sources.entry: MaCursor - Custom cursor themes for macOS. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/writronic/MaCursor) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]
MaCursor - Custom cursor themes for macOS. Replace any system cursor with custom artwork, with 75+ ready-to-apply themes and Windows .cur/.ani import.

summary.one_liner: MaCursor is a macOS app for replacing system cursors with custom artwork or ready-made cursor themes, with a visual theme editor and global hotkeys for switching.
summary.what_it_does: MaCursor lets you replace macOS system cursors with your own images or with downloadable .cursor themes from a built-in Theme Gallery, and switch themes with one click, a menu bar panel, or global keyboard shortcuts. A split-pane theme editor covers metadata, per-cursor image slots at 1x, 2x, 5x and 10x sizes, hotspot placement, animated GIF import and live preview. It can convert Windows .cur/.ani folders, Linux Xcursor folders and Mousecape .cape files into native themes. Extra features include per-app themes, theme automation on a day/night schedule or with light/dark appearance, cursor scale from 0.5x to 4x, cursor shadow, left/right hand mode, cursor trails, and mouse gestures. A right-click menu extension for Finder is also included. The README describes a background helper tool (MaCursorHelper) that is needed for several features to keep working.
use_cases: install custom cursor theme on Mac
convert Windows cursor pack to Mac
switch cursor theme with keyboard shortcut
design or edit cursor images with hotspot
how_to_run: Download the latest .dmg from the Releases page and drag MaCursor to Applications
Double-click a .cursor file or use File → Import Theme
Select a theme and click Apply
In MaCursor → Settings → General, click Install next to Helper Tool to keep the theme across restarts
notable: Converts Windows .cur/.ani, Linux Xcursor and Mousecape .cape themes into native .cursor themes with a review step
Per-app cursor themes that switch when an app comes to the front
Theme editor with hotspot dragging, live preview against black and white, and animated GIF to sprite sheet import
Right-click menu extension for Finder (copy path, new file, open with, hide files)
Mouse gestures and cursor trails, with a 'Focus on Hover' option
caveats: Several features (menu bar panel, gestures, per-app themes, shortcuts, automation) need the Helper Tool and some gestures or focus need Accessibility access
Cannot replace cursors drawn by websites, creative/CAD apps, games, or secure prompts such as the Lock Screen
Windows and Linux packs with only 32x32 artwork can look blurry unless larger versions are added
